## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put the phone with flat black screen to the right of the box with coffee mug design.

Task description: Move the black flat-screen phone in the middle of the table to the right of the small orange-and-white box with a coffee cup design at the front left, placing them roughly side by side on the table.

Success criteria: The phone must be on the nearby tabletop to the right of the box, approximately aligned front to back, with moderate spacing, neither touching nor too far away. The phone must be released and both grippers open. A position noticeably forward or behind the box on its right is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping middle sections of the phone's long edges, closing across its width with a slightly wider opening. Confirm the fingers surround the edges to avoid pressing the screen or pushing the phone away.
- The phone is thin. Use side-view observations to refine approach height so pads contact the frame without fingertips pressing the table. During a small lift, confirm stable movement off the table to reduce slipping.
- Keep the phone flat during placement. Leave room for fingers to open and withdraw near the box and light rectangular object on the right. Release after the table supports the phone to avoid dropping, flipping, or finger-induced displacement.
